name: monitor
author: LizardMan
description: Hold FN on any page to see what the OP-1 and every plugin cost: the CPU, the audio's load, its worst block and the blocks that came late, frames a second, memory, the OS's threads and the last crash. Fullscreen dims the page as the OP-1's help does; popup puts the main figures in a small box in a corner. It takes no key or turn, so everything plays on underneath, and a plugin shows red only while it goes over its CPU budget or is switched off. For the curious and for plugin authors.
